prompt: Wide hero shot of a bright, airy Seoul apartment living room at golden hour. A long low midnight-blue modular shelving unit stands against a warm white wall, styled with ceramics, art books and a small plant. A Korean woman in her late 20s in a cream knit cardigan sits on a sand-colored boucle sofa nearby reading, relaxed. Large windows with sheer curtains, light oak floor. Leave calm negative space in the left third of the frame for headline text.

Wide lifestyle shot of a colorful Seoul loft living room. A long low terracotta-orange modular sideboard with staggered open compartments sits under a big window, styled with records, a vintage speaker, and a few vases. A Korean couple in their 30s laughs on a deep blue corduroy sofa, warm afternoon light. Textured walls, rug with geometric pattern.

A Korean man in his 30s with a short beard, wearing a navy linen shirt, opens the door of a tall ivory modular wardrobe and storage wall in a calm Seoul apartment bedroom, choosing a shirt; neatly hung clothes visible inside. Soft daylight through sheer curtains, bed with linen bedding in the foreground. Subject positioned near the center of the frame.

A young Korean couple sits close together on the floor of their Seoul apartment, leaning against each other and smiling, looking at a tablet showing furniture colors. Behind them stands a tall olive-green modular bookcase with irregular open compartments filled with books and plants. Warm natural light, cozy and intimate. Subjects near the center of the frame.

A friendly Korean delivery worker in a plain black cap and black t-shirt (no logos) carefully carries a large flat cardboard furniture box into the entrance of a modern Seoul apartment, the front door open, light wood floor, shoe cabinet. Warm daylight, candid documentary style. Subject near the center of the frame.

A stylish Korean man in his 30s with long hair tied back and a black cap kneels on the living room floor of a Seoul apartment, smiling, attaching the last panel of a low natural oak modular TV stand with drawers, no tools needed. Plywood panels and an open flat box nearby. Soft daylight. Subject near the center of the frame.

Portrait of a creative Korean man in his early 30s with a mustache wearing a burnt-orange sweater, leaning with crossed arms in front of a large pink modular grid bookcase in his Hannam-dong apartment. The bookcase compartments are styled with a burgundy mushroom lamp, perfume bottles, a sculptural cream vase and art books. Pink wall, playful and confident.

A relaxed Korean man in his 20s lies on a chocolate-brown curvy modular sofa watching a game on TV in a cozy Seoul apartment living room. A low natural-oak modular TV stand with drawers holds the TV, a speaker beside it. Pendant paper lamp, terrazzo floor, window light. Calm everyday mood.

A stylish Korean woman in her 30s with short hair, wearing a striped lime-green shirt dress, lounges on a cobalt-blue corduroy armchair, gazing at the camera. Behind her a terracotta-orange modular shelving unit with staggered compartments holds vinyl records and a vintage radio. Bold colors, fashion-editorial mood, Seoul apartment.

A cheerful Korean woman in her 20s with a colorful outfit sits cross-legged on a rug in a vibrant Seoul studio, surrounded by bold graphic artworks. Behind her a burgundy modular shelving unit with irregular mosaic compartments filled with toys, books and ceramics. Playful, colorful, hip.

A Korean man in his 40s with salt-and-pepper hair in a navy corduroy shirt sits on a green velvet armchair with one leg crossed, in a colorful Seoul apartment. Behind him a midnight-blue modular cabinet with doors and open compartments, topped with sculptural colorful objects and a framed print. Relaxed, confident portrait.

An elegant Korean woman in her 30s in a white blouse and black trousers sits on a wooden chair in a minimal Seoul apartment. Beside her a tall ivory modular storage wall with doors and open compartments holding books and ceramics. Soft warm window light, serene mood.

Studio still life on a soft light grey background: several large thick colored panels (dusty pink, olive green, terracotta, navy blue) tilted at dynamic angles behind a frosted translucent glass gift card that faces the camera straight-on, perfectly flat and centered in the right half of the frame. The card surface is completely blank and plain. Soft studio lighting, crisp 3D product render aesthetic. Leave the left half calm and empty.

Close-up still life of furniture materials: a neat stack of furniture board samples showing their layered plywood edges, each sample finished in a different color (sage green, dusty pink, terracotta, ivory, natural oak, midnight blue), arranged on a light stone surface in a Seoul design studio, soft daylight, shallow depth of field, tactile and premium.

Wide interior of a furniture brand showroom in a converted brick factory in Seongsu-dong, Seoul: tall steel windows, polished concrete floor, white walls. Several modular shelving units and sideboards in midnight blue and terracotta are displayed on low concrete plinths, a lounge area with a pink sofa, a tablet kiosk for designing furniture. A few Korean visitors browsing. Daylight.

Inside a contemporary art gallery pop-up in Seongsu-dong, Seoul: a large burgundy modular shelving unit with irregular compartments displays art books, designer toys, posters and prints like a museum shop. Pink accent walls, bright gallery lighting.

Portrait of a Korean female product designer in her 40s with sleek blond-dyed hair pulled back and gold hoop earrings, wearing a black leather jacket, standing against a plain white wall with soft light, confident calm expression. Minimal editorial portrait.

A lively design workshop event in a Seoul studio: a group of young Korean creatives talking and laughing around a burgundy modular shelving unit, some holding drinks, colorful hand-painted banners on columns. Candid documentary photo, warm energy.

Dreamy soft-pink room: a pink modular grid shelving unit with rounded sculptural objects, a pink curvy lounge chair and a pastel rug, everything in harmonious shades of pink and peach, surreal yet photorealistic, gentle diffused light.
